name: Mariage
summary: 2-player trick-and-draw card game where holding king-queen of same suit scores bonus, ancestor of Sixty-Six and Schnapsen.
rules_text: Play with 32 cards ranking A > 10 > K > Q > J > 9 > 8 > 7 scoring Ace 11, Ten 10, King 4, Queen 3, Jack 2. Deal 6 cards each, 3+3, turning next card as trump; holder of trump 7 may rob it. Stock of 19 remains. In phase 1, lead any card, opponent may play any card, winner draws first, then loser. No need to follow suit. After winning a trick you may declare a mariage - King and Queen of same suit from hand - scoring 20 points, 40 in trumps, and Ace-Ten of trumps as amour for 40. Must have taken a trick to declare, before stock ends. Players may close the stock to commit to win from hand. Once stock is gone, phase 2: must follow suit, trump if void, and win if possible. 10 points for last trick. Total 130 points; 66 wins the deal.
